name: systematic-literature-review
description: Plan, conduct, validate, and report auditable systematic literature reviews without fabricating evidence or reviewer independence.

interface.longDescription: A cross-disciplinary workflow for prospective protocols, reproducible searches, reversible identity and deduplication, independent human screening and extraction gates, design-appropriate appraisal, explicit synthesis, certainty decisions, ledger-derived reporting, and review updates.
defaultPrompt: Plan a systematic health review and its prospective protocol.
Help me conduct a software-engineering systematic literature review.
Audit this review project without fabricating a second reviewer.
